title: Prepositions: let the case speak
subtitle: One preposition can change sense with a changed case.
overview: Learn a preposition with its case and a real phrase. Do not memorize bare English glosses.
Some prepositions change their usual sense with a different case, so parsing remains essential.

sections.title: Case-bound phrases
rows: μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν / μετὰ τὴν ἡμέραν
with the disciples / after the day

items.en: He or she remains in love.
He or she comes into the city.
He or she is from God.
